[User]
GAD, insomnia
Triggers: rumination, sleep anxiety.
Helps: thought records, sleep hygiene, limiting news.
Support: Tanvi (therapist).

[Recent sessions]
[Apr 4] Anxiety 6/10. Sleep 5 hrs. Described anxious thoughts keeping them awake — circular worry about work and health.
[Apr 5] Anxiety 9/10. Sleep 3-4 hrs. Both worsening together. Mentioned 'the anxiety causes the insomnia which makes the anxiety worse'. Tanvi appointment next week.
i feel like i'm spiralling and i can't find the brake
That sense of spiraling really makes sense after how much your sleep and anxiety have been feeding each other lately.
It’s like my brain just won’t stop, even when I know I should be trying to rest
I hear how exhausting it must feel to be stuck in that loop, even when you're trying to let go.
I keep thinking about what I should’ve said at work today — like, what if I messed up something important?
It’s so hard to quiet those thoughts when they’re already running so loud — but you’re not alone in feeling this way.
